name: figma-bridge
description: Self-hosted, local-only MCP bridge connecting Gemini CLI to Figma Desktop without Dev Mode or tokens.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @figma-bridge/shared && npm run build -w @figma-bridge/mcp-server && npm run build -w @figma-bridge/figma-plugin
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @figma-bridge/shared && npm run typecheck -w @figma-bridge/shared && npm run typecheck -w @figma-bridge/mcp-server && npm run typecheck -w @figma-bridge/figma-plugin
